findings.title: Observability of drive health telemetry, and what it shows

evidence.detail: no character device through which drive health could be read was found, so media health itself is unknown

completeness.statement: 2 of 2 load-bearing observations succeeded, so an absence found by them is evidence

evidence.access_model: the sensor process never opens a device node, and it never runs a tool that would open one on its behalf; the NVMe admin passthrough is gated on CAP_SYS_ADMIN, not on group membership, so even an openable node would not by itself yield SMART
evidence.remediation_note: obtaining SMART here needs CAP_SYS_ADMIN; adding the account to the disk group would not grant it, and recommending that would be a wrong instruction to an operator

findings.title: Redundancy of the root filesystem against the loss of one device

evidence.detail: the redundancy listings did not all succeed, so a single-device root cannot be asserted

findings.title: Whether every attached block device is accounted for

evidence.detail: attached but unaccounted for: sda, sdb, sdd, sde — the device carries no partition table and no filesystem signature known to udev, and has no holder, mount or swap entry. Whether prior-tenant data remains on it is unknown by design — the sensor does not open the device to find out what is on it
